final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g, b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
